cards.meaning: grace period; leeway before something is enforced
cards.example: Nagbigay ng palugit ang Senado sa dalawang senador bago ipatupad ang suspensyon.
cards.exampleMeaning: The Senate gave the two senators a grace period before enforcing the suspension.
cards.note: Panahong ibinibigay bago ang pagpapatupad o paniningil; kaiba sa 'taning' na tiyak at mahigpit na hangganan. Kadalasang kasunod ng 'magbigay' o 'humingi'.
cards.tiesTo: Senate holding Estrada and Marcoleta suspensions pending Sandiganbayan ruling

cards.example: Ang paratang ng Ombudsman laban sa hukom ay tinanggihan ng korte.
cards.exampleMeaning: The Ombudsman's accusation against the judge was rejected by the court.
cards.note: Pormal at legal ang dating; kaiba sa 'sumbong' na mas personal. Madalas na 'paratang laban sa' + tao o opisyal; ang diin ay nasa pagiging akusasyon, hindi sa katotohanan.
cards.tiesTo: Ombudsman's recusal bid against Sandiganbayan Justice Moreno

cards.example: 央行已经注入了大量资金，况且债券收益率还在创新低。
cards.examplePinyin: Yāngháng yǐjīng zhùrù le dàliàng zījīn, kuàngqiě zhàiquàn shōuyìlǜ hái zài chuàng xīn dī.
cards.exampleMeaning: The central bank has already injected a lot of money, and besides, bond yields keep hitting new lows.
cards.note: Mildly formal connective that stacks one more supporting reason onto an earlier one. Contrast 何况, which is rhetorical ('how much more so'); 况且 is calmer and suits analysis writing. Opens the second clause.
cards.tiesTo: PBOC record 1 trillion yuan injection with yields at record lows

cards.example: 刺激政策成功与否，取决于居民愿不愿意消费。
cards.examplePinyin: Cìjī zhèngcè chénggōng yǔfǒu, qǔjué yú jūmín yuàn bu yuànyì xiāofèi.
cards.exampleMeaning: Whether or not the stimulus succeeds depends on whether households are willing to spend.
cards.note: Formal written (书面语); follows a noun or verb to make an 'X or not' noun phrase that can be a subject (成功与否). Contrast 是否, a question word placed before the verb.
cards.tiesTo: Whether China's liquidity push revives demand
